_doc: ADR-0089 (grill-t32) D-D: the orphan-cite registry - append-only, machine-readable classification input for the rewrite-map classifier. One entry type, purely declarative fields; entries are never edited or deleted, supersession is a newer registered_at. Written ONLY by the explicit verbs in scripts/orphan-cites.js (register / backfill) - the classifier never writes here. Human-facing disclosure lives in ERRATA.md; the two channels are independent. Adjudication: multiple entries per cited_sha resolve by latest registered_at; disposition:revived returns the cite to existence-fact classification.
